title: Selected-mail timeline
blurb: Open a message and choose Timeline beside Summary. This downloaded thread keeps the lightweight chronology. Case / client mode searches the current account's local downloaded mail across threads; choose messages, Main / Background roles, Review selected mail and confirm coverage/destination before Generate. Multiple local searches can add to a selection; no thread expands automatically in Case mode. If the opened thread exceeds its capture limits, Case mode can still search the account and review a smaller explicit selection. Local search matches all token prefixes in subject, sender and indexed body, not Gmail syntax or To/Cc. The body index covers at most 200,000 characters per message; each query shows at most 100 results and flags limited queries. Search and selected mail never prove complete mailbox coverage. Optional keywords and contact emails guide extraction, not source selection. AI receives reviewed body text and quoted history, subjects, sender names/addresses, mail timestamps/provenance, attachment names, optional focus and Main/Background choices. Independent To/Cc headers remain local evidence; addresses can still occur in body or focus. Thread mode displays its account. Case search shows which account it searches, beside the search field. Review shows the account, selected and included message counts, omissions and saved AI destination. No extra account selection is required. Only Generate starts AI. A change to the saved connection requires reopening and reviewing the Timeline or Case. Case reports add cited current status, review follow-ups, unresolved gaps and separately labelled mentioned events/deadlines. Suggestions do not automatically complete tasks or equate unread/silence with unfinished work. The full mail-date chronology stays available with Main / Background filters. Read cached source opens inert local evidence without downloads or mark-read; changed/deleted sources can be unavailable. Window-owned source snapshots, account revalidation, omitted-message acceptance, no-usable-body blocking and 1,000-message / 200-thread ceilings remain. Local scanning is bounded to 1,024,000 UTF-8 bytes. Remaining body text is bounded to 512,000 UTF-8 bytes and serialized run input to 512,000 bytes, with at most 32 requests, 32,000 output tokens and 10 minutes. Existing in-request references apply to exact >-quoted complete bodies. Before Generate, Morrow checks marked quotations against earlier complete mail in the selected thread and uses the smaller plan when it saves requests or meaningful input bytes without adding requests. Each reply keeps its own entry and newly written text. See Sources and text processing for the exact savings. Edited, unmarked and uncertain quotes stay intact. Original bodies, authors, dates and fingerprints remain unchanged. Sources and text processing shows per-message body/literal byte counts, shared quotes and planned requests before generation. These byte estimates are not tokenizer measurements or exact prices. Lower run budgets can stop smaller selections. Preflight includes the complete request and optional focus. Failed runs show attempted AI request counts and a fixed extraction, consolidation or case failure category: JSON formatting, fields/text limits, source references or incomplete output. One bounded retry receives fixed corrective guidance without echoing raw provider output. A single whole-response JSON fence is accepted; schema and source checks remain strict. An explicit retry revalidates the same source and sends the reviewed mail again. The estimate covers initial extraction; case synthesis, one validation retry per step and bounded reductions share the same call, usage and time limits. Failure shows attempted AI calls; explicit retry can resend reviewed mail. Closing cancels later calls; delivered data cannot be recalled. Case title is editable; supported language and timezone follow the system. Thread title follows the subject. Saved results remain local outside Brain and Agent history. Reviewed HTML, Markdown, isolated PDF and public JSON exports preserve scope, uncertainty and evidence; thread JSON remains 1.0.0, Case JSON is 1.1.0, and older saved artifacts remain readable. If indentation would exceed 2 MiB, JSON keeps all fields in compact form. Each HTML and PDF entry identifies its sender, To and Cc recipients, and source message. Each export requires fresh review. Account removal deletes related timelines, including mixed-account results; exported files, backups and historical journal bytes remain. No URL/webhook export, bot operation, CLI command, scheduled generation, attachment-content extraction or exact price estimate is available.
